title: Basic Greenhouse
keywords: Automatically constructed starter greenhouse with eight growing cells around central water

blocks.text: Automatically constructed starter greenhouse with eight growing cells around central water.

rows: Load logs, stairs, glass and planks into its first four inputs, then press Build.
Prepare dirt/grass beneath the growing area and supply compatible seeds.
Use a Gas Lantern for carbon and an outside chest for permitted seed/produce automation.

blocks.text: Its roof is wider than the crop area. Wrong construction-slot order, missing energy, denied targets or higher-tier seeds can stall it.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
